scenes.headline: How Edge0 serves a 35B model from SSD
scenes.sub: Experts stay on disk, and a trained prerouter reads them one token early.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Latte! Edge0 runs a thirty-five-billion-parameter mixture of experts in about three gigabytes of memory. Here's how the experts stay on disk.

scenes.text: Keep the experts on SSD, and predict the next layer's routing one token early, so disk reads overlap compute instead of stalling it.

scenes.label: of the parameters are routed experts, which never need to stay in RAM
scenes.say: Why this can work: ninety-two point nine percent of the parameters are routed experts. The rest, attention, embeddings and the output head among them, stays resident.

steps.say: Expert weights sit on SSD as int4 files, memory-mapped, and fault in only when a token needs them.
The catch: layer N plus one's experts depend on layer N's output. So every read waits for the router. Forty layers, forty stalls.
So Edge0 adds a small prerouter head. It predicts the next layer's experts from this layer's state at the previous token.
Now the reads start early, and overlap compute.

steps.note: a recovery LoRA pays for the approximation in training
steps.say: And the prediction is used as the routing. What was staged is what runs, so nothing is dropped and nothing reloads.

left.title: Model fits in memory
items: Page cache holds the working set
No cold reads left to hide
left.say: On a Mac mini that can hold the model, the page cache already has the experts, and the prerouter adds two point five percent.

right.title: Model cannot fit
items: Every step faults experts from SSD
Reads move off the critical path
right.say: On a sixteen-gigabyte MacBook that can't hold it, every step faults from disk. Moving reads off the critical path buys eighty to eighty-four percent.

scenes.text: The prerouter is a swap-avoidance device: it pays in proportion to how badly the machine can't hold the model.

recap: Experts live on SSD, not in RAM
A prerouter predicts the next layer's experts
The prediction is the routing; nothing reloads
scenes.say: To recap: experts on disk, reads issued a token early, and a prediction that is the routing.
